title: Unit Event — Aim Higher and Higher! — Episode8 The Goal Before Us

meta.Event Outline: The day of Taiga and Ken's event has finally arrived. The members of Vivid BAD SQUAD are looking forward to this world-class event, when an incident leads to an unexpected reunion.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The world's biggest music festival...

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line:
Wait, Lasting ECHO Fest...?
You guys are gonna be performing there, Taiga?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I've heard the name before.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But the only thing I know is that it's a really, really big music festival...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: It's a festival where artists from all around the world gather to perform.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Top-level musicians from every genre you can imagine. Rock, jazz, classical, street and even traditional folk. It takes place over three days and three nights.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Three days and three nights...?!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
And we're not being figurative.
It's three days of nonstop music.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Everyone there, the artists and the crowd both, is going to sing and play until they have nothing left to give.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That sounds like such an amazing festival...

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: Yeah. The lineup for SONIC NOTES was pretty honestly ridiculous...

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: But Lasting ECHO Fest is in a league of its own.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, I've heard...
Only the best of the best in the entire world get to perform at Lasting ECHO Fest.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: That's right.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: The sheer number of sponsors, artists and people who come to watch...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: No other event comes close to even touching Lasting ECHO Fest. In other words...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Getting to sing there is proof that you're one of the world's best.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: One of the world's best...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Lasting ECHO Fest...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (An event that's even bigger than the one we just experienced.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (People from all over the world are going to come and watch.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I want to perform in it...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I thought something after seeing you two perform today, Taiga.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I want to sing like that...
I want to grab our audience's hearts and light a fire under them.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I want us to turn the world upside down with our music.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That's what it means to stand on top of the world!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I thought the same thing!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I want to perform at the biggest event in the world and get the crowd going more than anybody else...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Then we can say that we're standing on top of the world, right?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Our goal seems much clearer to me now as well.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: To stand on stage, sing and create that level of excitement.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sounds like we're all decided.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: All that's left is for us to keep running until we get there.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I don't care how unprepared we are. It's happening. We're gonna stand on top of the world!

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: Sounds like we have the same destination in mind.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line:
We feel the same way!
How could we not after seeing that performance?!

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: Right. It reminded me of the first time we ever saw RADder sing.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line:
I felt just as excited...
No, my heart was racing even faster.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You guys too...?!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I like your guts. Well...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Go and give it your best shot.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Oh, but...
I can also reward your guts with a bit of good news.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Good news?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Like I said, only the best of the best get to appear at Lasting ECHO Fest.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Honestly, we're mostly going because we got lucky.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
I'm sure they've got a bunch of criteria for who they pick, but...
Either way, you guys aren't even on their radar.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: However, you still have a chance.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: A little while before this year's festival, they decided to start looking for up-and-coming new artists who are hot right now. Sort of a “focus on the new generation” type of deal.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: So, they've decided to open one slot per genre. The young artists who are chosen will get to perform as the opening acts...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: And yeah, I mean on the main stage at Lasting ECHO Fest.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So basically, if you can prove you're the best in your genre, you get to perform in the festival?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, how do they decide who's the best?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: For street music, that slot will be reserved for the winners of a certain event.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: A certain event?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: RUSH BEATS.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: It's a tournament where young artists like you will be competing for a chance to perform at Lasting ECHO Fest.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: It takes place here in the United States, but anyone is free to enter as long as they're of a certain skill level.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Doesn't it sound like a golden opportunity?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: We're going to get the crowd going more than anyone else at Lasting ECHO Fest. We'll be the ones standing on top of the world...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: If you want to fight for that title, then come and get it.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Win at RUSH BEATS and then come and stand in our way.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: That is, if you can.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Us performing at the world's biggest music festival...?!

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: We're not gonna let this chance slip, are we?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
No way!
Not if it means a shot at standing on that stage.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. And...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The view from up there is probably what lies beyond Aunt Nagi's dream.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, we have to go...!

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: Which makes us rivals.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It is a tournament, so it is likely we'll face off against each other.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: However...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If that slot is on the line, then we can't afford to lose.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line:
That's what I like to hear!
And there's no way we're gonna let you guys walk away with it!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hah. Alright, challenge accepted.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Heh. Ah, youth.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Yeah, but I like your guys' moxie.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I want us to turn the world upside down with our music.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That's what it means to stand on top of the world!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Man. This feels kind of nostalgic, huh?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
Nostalgic? It's making me want to crawl out of my skin.
It's like someone's making me look at a mirror.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Haha. Yeah, I get that.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: They're really trying to reach the same place as us.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: But we're not about to let them play through.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: They may be aiming for the same goal, but we're going to get there first. Yeah?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Yeah.
